gloss: to drift ashore; to wash up

definitions.gloss: to drift ashore; to wash up; to end up (somewhere)
definitions.explanation: To be carried by water or a current until reaching a shore. Also used figuratively of a person who drifts from place to place and finally ends up somewhere.

examples.english: A bottle washed up on the beach.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流木|りゅうぼく}→流木：28678_ryuuboku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{流|なが}れ{着|つ}いた。
examples.english: After the typhoon, driftwood washed up on the shore.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{転々|てんてん}→転々：03975_tenten⟧とした⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{港町|みなとまち}→港町：14845_minatomachi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{流|なが}れ{着|つ}いた。
examples.english: After moving from job to job, he finally ended up in this little port town.

notes:
Combines ⟦{流|なが}れる→流れる：01969_nagareru⟧ (to flow, to be carried) and ⟦{着|つ}く→着く：00680_tsuku⟧ (to arrive). The arrival point takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧; the place carried from takes から.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{海岸|かいがん}→海岸：00852_kaigan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{流|なが}れ{着|つ}く: to wash up on the shore
- {漂流物|ひょうりゅうぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{流|なが}れ{着|つ}く: drifting debris washes ashore
- ⟦{島|しま}→島：00885_shima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{流|なが}れ{着|つ}く: to be washed up on an island

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{漂着|ひょうちゃく}→漂着：16933_hyouchaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to drift ashore — the formal Sino-Japanese equivalent, common in news reports
- ⟦{打|う}ち{上|あ}げられる→打ち上げる：06732_uchiageru⟧: to be washed up (by the waves) — emphasizes the waves throwing something onto land
